{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Compute response rates by arm
response_rates = trial_df.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Extract treatment and control response rates
treatment_rate = response_rates['treatment']
control_rate = response_rates['control']

# Compute treatment effect as difference in proportions (treatment - control)
treatment_effect = treatment_rate - control_rate

# Print the result
treatment_effect"}
